name: Ogrekin Human Fighter 4
body:
Ogrekin Human Fighter 4
CR 4

XP 1,200
Male ogrekin human fighter 4
CE Medium humanoid (giant, augmented humanoid)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE
AC 18, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+4 armor, +1 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 50 (4d10+24)
Fort +9, Ref +2, Will +3 (+4 against fear)

OFFENSE
Speed 20 ft.
Melee Large greatclub +12 (2d8+12)

STATISTICS
Str 24, Dex 13, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +11; CMD 22
Feats Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (greatclub), Weapon Specialization (greatclub)
Skills Climb +14, Intimidate +7
Languages Common
SQ armor training +1, bravery +1, deformities
Gear +1 studded leather armor, Large greatclub

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deformities (Ex)
Lazrul’s right arm is exceptionally large and muscular, allowing him to wield a Large greatclub without additional penalty, but his legs are stunted and short and his left foot deformed into a club foot, resulting in a reduced base speed.
